### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. corneal dystrophy, Fuchs endothelial, 4  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.732)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:16438)

**Proposed mechanism:** SLC4A11 (HGNC:10602) —DISRUPTS→ Epithelial cell hydration and ion transport (GO:0001652); Epithelial cell hydration and ion transport (GO:0001652) —LEADS_TO→ Corneal dystrophy (HP:0000547); Epithelial cell hydration and ion transport (GO:0001652) —LEADS_TO→ Fuchs endothelial corneal dystrophy (HP:0011793); SLC4A11 (HGNC:10602) —DISRUPTS→ Perceptive deafness (HP:0000388). Loss-of-function mutations in SLC4A11 disrupt epithelial cell hydration and ion transport, leading to corneal dystrophy and perceptive deafness in corneal dystrophy-perceptive deafness syndrome, and Fuchs endothelial corneal dystrophy in Fuchs endothelial corneal dystrophy 4.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in SLC4A11 with different functional consequences (e.g., one disease requiring loss-of-function and the other gain-of-function) or the absence of SLC4A11 variants in affected individuals. _(variant: The presence of common benign variants in SLC4A11 in gnomAD populations that are also found in affected individuals would challenge the pathogenicity.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of SLC4A11 in these conditions could lead to the development of targeted therapies for corneal dystrophies and hearing loss, potentially by modulating ion transport or cellular hydration.

#### 2. congenital hereditary endothelial dystrophy of cornea  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.724)

Loss-of-function mutations in SLC4A11 disrupt chloride-bicarbonate transport, leading to corneal dystrophy and perceptive deafness in corneal dystrophy-perceptive deafness syndrome, and congenital hereditary endothelial dystrophy of the cornea.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in SLC4A11 that are clearly associated with gain-of-function or dominant-negative effects, or the absence of any SLC4A11 variants in affected individuals across multiple independent cohorts. _(variant: rs141102951)_
